FEEDBACK: Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 constraint on nltl:constructionContractDate. The requirement is conditional and does not independently require every ship to have a construction contract date; absence of the date must not create a violation outside the applicability interval. Retain the direct-static check that, when the supplied date is on or after 2012-01-01 and before 2019-01-01, the ship has nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2010.

Candidate faithfully implements the conditional direct-static requirement: it targets ships, validates supplied construction contract dates as xsd:date, applies the inclusive 2012-01-01 lower bound and exclusive 2019-01-01 upper bound, and requires the 2010 regulation edition only within that interval. The prior instruction to omit unconditional sh:minCount 1 is preserved.
